rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a problem, technical difficulty, or vague personal concern.

example.english: How should we resolve this issue?
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 jiu3 dim2 joeng6 gaai2 kyut3

rows.note: Use this for sending something out, especially a notice, order, or other official document, rather than circulating money or publications.

example.english: The school is preparing to issue a school-closure notice.
example.traditional: 學校準備發出停課通知。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 zeon2 bei6 faat3 ceot1 ting4 fo3 tung1 zi1

rows.note: Use this for putting money, shares, or publications into circulation, rather than simply sending or handing something out.

example.english: The company plans to issue new shares.
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 gai3 waak6 faat3 hang4 san1 gu2

rows.note: Use this when an organization hands items out for people to use, such as uniforms, forms, or supplies.

example.english: The school will issue new uniforms to the students today.
example.traditional: 學校今日派發新校服畀學生。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 gam1 jat6 paai3 faat3 san1 haau6 fuk6 bei2 hok6 saang1

rows.note: Use this when the issue specifically concerns a point of disagreement or dispute.

example.english: Whether to raise the price is still an issue of dispute.
example.jyutping: gaa1 m4 gaa1 gaa3 zung6 jau5 zaang1 ji5

rows.note: Use this for a particular edition of a newspaper, magazine, or other periodical, as in 今期.

example.english: This issue of the magazine is really good.
example.jyutping: gam1 kei4 bun2 zaap6 zi3 hou2 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use this for the official production or release of currency or another item for general use.

example.english: The government will issue new banknotes next month.
example.traditional: 政府下個月會發行新鈔。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 faat3 hang4 san1 caau1

rows.note: Use this when liquid or another substance flows out from a source.

example.english: The issue is that water is flowing out of the bottle.
example.traditional: 個問題係樽入面啲水流出嚟。
example.jyutping: go3 man6 tai4 hai6 zeon1 jap6 min6 di1 seoi2 lau4 ceot1 lei4
